name: io.github.jeang42/codemem
title: codemem
description: Shared memory for coding agents: projects, reusable code, sessions and commits across machines

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server and web UI

environmentVariables.name: CODEMEM_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the database and backups

environmentVariables.name: CODEMEM_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite database (overrides CODEMEM_DATA)

environmentVariables.name: CODEMEM_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Address to bind. The server has no authentication; use 127.0.0.1 unless the network is trusted

environmentVariables.name: CODEMEM_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for MCP (/mcp) and the web UI. The transport URL assumes 8055

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama base URL for embeddings (semantic search). Without it, search is BM25 only

environmentVariables.name: CODEMEM_EMBED
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable embeddings entirely

environmentVariables.name: GIT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory of bare git repos to read for the commit feed
